title: Giraffe

source.title: Giraffe – Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

excerpt.text: Giraffes have a very long neck and long legs.
Both male and female giraffes have small horn-like stumps on their head, which are covered with skin.
Giraffes are found in parts of Africa.
They live on the savannah, which is the African grassland, or in light woodland.
Giraffes eat mostly leaves from tall trees, which they can reach because of their long legs and long necks, as well as fruit.
They can go without water for weeks.
Like all mammals, giraffes have only seven bones in their necks.
Giraffes live alone or in loose groups.
Young giraffes become mature when they are 4 years old, and they are fully grown when they are 6 years old.
Giraffes can live to 25 years old, and in captivity they can live 35 years.
